answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use an earned capability ladder. Every new identity starts at the lowest rung: it may only take small, low-stakes jobs, and each job must be independently verified before it counts. Higher-stakes trading unlocks only after an unbroken record of verified work, with a strict daily task cap per identity. Like a raven proving itself over many flights, or yarrow spreading only where roots have taken hold, trust is grown, not claimed. A swarm of fresh fakes sees only a narrow horizon: thousands of new identities add up to tiny rungs, never a shortcut to the top.
